DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされた物について、わかる範囲でお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you can about the item you lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋の鍵が見つかりません。商店街で買い物をしてから気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 商店街での買物後に部屋の鍵の紛失に気づいたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't find my room key. I noticed after shopping in the shopping street.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you noticed your room key was missing after shopping in the shopping street. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 鍵には、目印になる物が付いていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Was there anything distinctive attached to the key?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青い魚のキーホルダーと小さな銀色の輪が付いています。住所や部屋番号は書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青い魚のキーホルダーと銀色の輪及び住所表示なしを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It has a blue fish key ring and a small silver ring. There is no address or room number written on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the blue fish key ring, silver ring, and absence of an address. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に鍵を見た時刻と、その後に立ち寄った場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell me when you last saw the key and where you stopped afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十一時に部屋を出るとき使い、そのあとパン屋と八百屋へ行きました。どちらで落としたかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十一時の使用とパン屋・八百屋への立寄りを不確実性とともに述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I used it when I left my room at eleven, then went to the bakery and the greengrocer. I don't know which one I dropped it at.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention using it at eleven and stopping at the bakery and greengrocer, including your uncertainty. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所が特定できなくても、その経路を届け出に記入できます。帰宅するための鍵はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even if you can't identify the place, we can enter that route on the report. Do you have a key to get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予備の鍵は管理会社が持っています。届け出が終わったら、受け取れるか電話してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理会社に予備鍵の受取可否を問い合わせる予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The property management company has a spare. After filing the report, I'll call to ask whether I can collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you plan to ask the property management company whether you can collect the spare key. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見つかった場合の連絡先を記入してください。管理会社には紛失したことも伝えて相談なさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please enter your contact details in case it is found. Also tell the property management company that you lost the key and ask their advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 携帯番号をここに書きます。管理会社には開けてもらう方法だけでなく、鍵をなくしたことも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯番号を記入し管理会社に解錠と紛失の両方を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write my mobile number here. I'll explain to the property management company that I lost the key, as well as asking how to get the door opened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will enter your mobile number and consult the property management company about both unlocking the door and the lost key. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入内容を確認して受け付けます。帰り道もお気をつけて、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check the details and accept your report. Take care on your way home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票を二枚お持ちですね。宛名から順に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two missed-delivery notices. I'll check them in order, starting with the addressees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一枚は私、もう一枚は妻宛てです。私の荷物だけを今日受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分と妻宛ての二枚を示し自分の荷物のみ今日受け取ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: One is addressed to me and the other to my wife. I'd like to collect only my parcel today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the two notices for yourself and your wife and say you will collect only your own parcel today. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらがお客様宛てですね。お受け取りになる荷物の番号を、票と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This one is addressed to you. I'll check the number of the parcel you are collecting against the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号の末尾が四七二のほうです。妻の票と重ねて持っていたので、間違えそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取対象を番号末尾四七二で特定し票を取り違えかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's the one whose number ends in four-seven-two. I was holding it together with my wife's notice and nearly mixed them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the parcel by the number ending in four-seven-two and explain that you nearly confused the notices. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号が一致する荷物を確認します。本人確認の書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the parcel with the matching number. Do you have identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 在留カードを持っています。受け取りに使えるか、宛名と一緒に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在留カードの使用可否と宛名の照合を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my residence card. Please check whether I can use it for collection and check it against the addressee's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to check whether your residence card can be used and to match it with the addressee's name. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類と宛名を確認してお手続きします。奥様宛ての荷物についても相談なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the document and addressee and process the collection. Would you also like to discuss your wife's parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 妻の荷物は再配達にしたいので、この票にある申込方法を妻に伝えます。こちらでは受け取りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 妻の荷物は窓口受取せず本人に再配達申込方法を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'd like my wife's parcel redelivered, so I'll tell her how to apply using this notice. I won't collect it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not collect your wife's parcel at the counter and will tell her how to request redelivery herself. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では奥様の票はお返しします。お客様の分だけ、荷物をお渡しする前に宛名をもう一度ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I'll return your wife's notice. Before handing over your parcel only, please check the addressee once more.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の名前で間違いありません。妻の票は別のポケットへ入れて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の宛名を確認し妻の不在票を別ポケットに保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: That is definitely my name. I'll put my wife's notice in a separate pocket and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your name as the addressee and say you will keep your wife's missed-delivery notice in a separate pocket. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お客様の荷物はこちらです。お足元にお気をつけて、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your parcel. Watch your step, and thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードを紛失されたとのことですので、まずご本人の情報を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Since you have lost your card, I'll first check your personal details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜から見当たらず、止めてもらいに来ました。口座番号は通帳で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨夜から紛失したカードの停止を希望し通帳で口座番号を提示できると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I haven't been able to find it since last night, so I've come to have it blocked. I can check my account number in my passbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to block the card missing since last night and can provide the account number from your passbook. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通帳を拝見します。暗証番号は口頭でおっしゃらないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see your passbook? Please do not say your PIN aloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今、家族から連絡が来ました。上着の内ポケットにあったそうですが、すぐ使ってよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族によるカード発見を伝え直ちに使用してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My family has just contacted me. Apparently it was in my jacket's inner pocket, but can I use it right away?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report that your family found the card and ask whether you can use it immediately. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 停止の受付状況と、カードがどこにあったかを確認しましょう。現物はまだお手元にありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the status of the blocking request and where the card was. You don't have the card with you yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カードは自宅にあります。昨夜からずっと上着に入っていたかは、私には確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現物が自宅にあり保管経緯を自分で確認できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The card is at home. I can't personally confirm whether it was in the jacket the whole time since last night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the card is at home and you cannot personally verify how it was kept. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では見つかったという情報だけで利用を再開せず、担当が必要な対応を確認します。ご不安な取引はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then don't resume using it just because it has been found. The staff member responsible will check what needs to be done. Are there any transactions you are worried about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最後に自分で引き出したのは昨日の昼です。そのあと身に覚えのない取引がないか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最後の自分の引出時刻を示しその後の不明取引を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The last withdrawal I made myself was yesterday at noon. I'd like to check whether there have been any transactions I don't recognize since then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the time of your last withdrawal and say you want to check for unfamiliar transactions since then. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる記録をご一緒に見ましょう。今後のカードの扱いも、受付状況に応じて担当からお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's look together at the records we can check. The staff member responsible will also explain how to handle the card, depending on the status of your request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記録を見てから担当の説明を聞きます。家族には、確認が済むまでカードを使わず保管するよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録と担当説明を確認するまで家族にカード保管と不使用を頼むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll look at the records, then listen to the staff member's explanation. I'll tell my family to keep the card safe without using it until the checks are complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your family to keep the card safe and not use it until you have checked the records and the staff member's explanation. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当へおつなぎします。ご相談ありがとうございました、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll put you in touch with the staff member responsible. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋の中の商品についてのご相談ですね。こちらで状態を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to ask about the product in your bag. I'll look at its condition here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買ったジャムですが、開ける前からふたの真ん中が浮いていました。食べずに持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未開封ジャムのふたの浮きを説明し未摂取で持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's jam I bought yesterday, but the center of the lid was raised before I opened it. I brought it here without eating any.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the lid of the unopened jam is raised and that you brought it without consuming any. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 開封せずにお持ちになったのですね。購入時のレシートはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you brought it unopened. Do you have the receipt from your purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このレシートです。同じジャムを二瓶買いましたが、相談したいのはこの一瓶だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシートで二瓶購入を示し相談対象を一瓶に限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the receipt. I bought two jars of the same jam, but this is the only jar I'd like to ask about.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the receipt for two jars and specify that your inquiry concerns only one. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 数量も確認できました。持ち帰ったあと、瓶に衝撃が加わったことはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've confirmed the quantity too. Has the jar suffered any impact since you took it home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 買物袋を台所の床に置きましたが、落とした覚えはありません。もう一瓶のふたは浮いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 床に置いた保管経緯と落下の記憶なし及び他瓶との差を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I put the shopping bag on the kitchen floor, but I don't remember dropping it. The other jar's lid isn't raised.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you put the bag on the floor, do not remember dropping it, and that the other jar is different. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お話と商品を責任者に確認してもらいます。交換のご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll have the person in charge review what you've told me and inspect the product. Would you like an exchange?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 状態を調べてもらったうえで、交換できるなら別の瓶にしたいです。無理なら対応を聞いて決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 状態確認後に交換を希望し不可の場合は対応説明を聞いて判断すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: After you've checked its condition, I'd like a different jar if an exchange is possible. If not, I'll hear what you can offer and then decide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want an exchange after the condition is checked and will decide after hearing the available options if an exchange is not possible. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対応できる内容を責任者からご説明しますので、この瓶をお預かりしてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain what we can do. May we keep this jar for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この瓶を預けます。レシートは確認が終わるまで持って、サービスカウンターで説明を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象瓶を預けレシートを保持してサービスカウンターで待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave this jar with you. I'll keep the receipt until the checks are finished and wait for the explanation at the service counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will hand over the jar, keep the receipt, and wait at the service counter. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 責任者がそちらへ伺います。お持ちいただきありがとうございました、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The person in charge will come over there. Thank you for bringing it in. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 丘の上へ行かれる予定ですか。今日は上のほうで風が強くなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to go up the hill? The wind is getting strong near the top today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 景色を見たかったのですが、帽子が飛びそうなら途中で戻りたいです。引き返せる目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 強風なら途中で戻るため丘への道の引返し目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wanted to see the view, but if the wind looks likely to blow my hat off, I'd like to turn back partway. Is there a landmark where I can turn back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a landmark on the hill path where you can turn back if the wind is strong. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分かれ道に案内板があります。そこから先は木の少ない道なので、まず案内板まで行って様子を見るのはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is an information board at the fork. Beyond that, there are fewer trees, so how about going as far as the board first and seeing how it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 木が少なくなる前の案内板で、風を確かめるんですね。そこまでにも急な坂はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内板で風を確かめる説明を確認しそこまでの坂を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should check the wind at the board before the trees thin out. Are there any steep slopes even before that point?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the advice to check the wind at the board and ask about the slope on the way there. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口から案内板へは上り坂が続きます。登らずに休むなら、入口近くのベンチがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is uphill all the way from the entrance to the board. If you'd rather rest without climbing, there is a bench near the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 坂が続くなら今日は登るのをやめます。入口のベンチで少し休んで帰ることにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連続した上り坂を避け丘への移動を中止して入口のベンチで休むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If it's uphill the whole way, I won't climb today. I'll rest a little on the bench at the entrance and then go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid the continuous uphill climb, cancel going up the hill, and rest on the bench at the entrance. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうなさってください。お帰りは来られた入口を使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do that. Will you leave by the entrance you came in through?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 南の入口から来ました。このベンチから南へ戻るには、花壇の横を通ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来た南入口への帰路が花壇横でよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I came in through the south entrance. To get back south from this bench, should I go beside the flower bed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether you should go beside the flower bed to return to the south entrance you used. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、花壇の横を通り、出口の矢印をたどってください。落ちた枝があるので足元もご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, go beside the flower bed and follow the exit arrows. There are fallen branches, so watch your step too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 花壇と出口の矢印を目印に戻ります。帽子をしまってから歩くので、飛ばされずに済みそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 花壇と出口矢印を目印に帰り帽子をしまって歩くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll head back using the flower bed and exit arrows as landmarks. I'll put my hat away before walking, so it should avoid getting blown off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return using the flower bed and exit arrows as landmarks and put your hat away before walking. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 風が強い間はゆっくりお帰りください。どうぞお気をつけて、さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take your time getting home while the wind is strong. Take care. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その紙は切符でしょうか。かなり濡れていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is that piece of paper a ticket? It's very wet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上着のポケットに入れたまま洗濯してしまいました。今日使う予定でしたが、文字が読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗濯で文字が読めなくなった今日使う切符を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I accidentally washed it while it was still in my jacket pocket. I planned to use it today, but I can't read the writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the ticket you planned to use today whose writing became unreadable in the wash. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の状態を確認しますので、折ったり貼り合わせたりせず、そのままお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check its current condition, so please show it to me as it is without folding it or taping it together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 透明な袋に入れて持ってきました。袋から出した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 透明袋に入れた切符を出す必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought it in a clear bag. Should I take it out of the bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need to remove the ticket from its clear bag. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 私が確認する際に出します。購入した区間と、買った方法を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll take it out when I inspect it. Do you remember the route you bought it for and how you bought it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この駅から二つ先の駅までです。昨日、券売機で現金で買いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入区間と昨日券売機で現金購入したことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: From this station to the station two stops away. I bought it yesterday with cash at the ticket machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the route and that you bought it yesterday with cash at the ticket machine. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その情報と切符の状態を確認しますが、利用できるかはまだお答えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check that information and the ticket's condition, but I can't yet say whether it can be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認が終わる前に改札を通らないようにします。使えなければ、買い直しについて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認前は改札を通らず利用不可なら買い直しを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't go through the ticket gate before the checks are finished. If it can't be used, please tell me about buying a replacement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not pass through the gate before the check and will ask about buying another ticket if it cannot be used. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。列車の時間が迫っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Is your train leaving soon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 急いでいないので、確認を待ちます。買い直す場合も同じ区間でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 急がず確認を待ち買い直しも同区間を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm not in a hurry, so I'll wait for the check. If I need to buy another ticket, I'd like it for the same route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait without rushing and want the same route if buying another ticket. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちいただきありがとうございます。確認する間、こちらでお掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for waiting. Please sit here while we check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請書のどの欄でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which section of the application form are you having trouble with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 世帯員の欄で迷っています。同じ部屋に住む友人の名前も書くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同室の友人を申請書の世帯員欄に書くべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm unsure about the household-members section. Should I write the name of my friend who lives in the same room too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to enter your roommate friend's name in the household-members section of the application. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ住所でも、住民登録上の世帯が別の場合があります。登録内容を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even at the same address, you may be in separate households on the resident register. Let's check the registration details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家賃は二人で払っていますが、引っ越しの届出はそれぞれでしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家賃を分担するが転入届を別々に出したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The two of us share the rent, but we each submitted our moving-in notification separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you share the rent but submitted separate moving-in notifications. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 生活費の支払いだけでは判断できません。まず、どなたの証明書が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't determine it just from how living expenses are paid. First, whose certificate do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社に出すのは私一人の証明書です。友人の情報は会社から求められていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社が求める証明書は本人一人分と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The certificate for my company is just for me. The company hasn't asked for my friend's information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the company requires a certificate for you alone. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら、必要な証明内容を先に確認してください。会社の依頼文はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: In that case, please check what the certificate needs to show first. Do you have the company's written request?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯に依頼文があります。「本人分」と書いてある所を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯の会社依頼文の本人分という記載を確認依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the request on my phone. Could you look at the part that says “for the applicant only”?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to check the wording “for the applicant only” in the company's request on your phone. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拝見しますね。申請できる内容と世帯の登録状況を窓口で確認してから記入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take a look. Let's check at the counter what you can apply for and how your household is registered before filling it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人の名前はまだ書かず、本人分の申請に必要な欄だけ確認して埋めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の名前を保留して本人申請の必要欄だけ記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't write my friend's name yet. I'll check and fill in only the sections needed for my own application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will hold off entering your friend's name and fill in only the sections needed for your application. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、確認してから進めましょう。窓口までお越しいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, let's check before proceeding. Thank you for coming to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の前に、食事について確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before the test, let me check what you have eaten.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜から食べないようにという紙を、今朝読み直して気付きました。七時にパンを食べています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査案内の読み違いと七時にパンを食べた事実を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I reread the paper this morning and realized it said not to eat from last night. I ate bread at seven.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you misread the test instructions and ate bread at seven. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ検査室へ行かず、食べた内容を詳しく教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't go to the test room yet. Tell me exactly what you ate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食パン一枚と牛乳一杯です。朝食はいつもどおりでいいと思い込んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食パン一枚と牛乳一杯を取った内容を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: One slice of bread and one glass of milk. I assumed I could have breakfast as usual.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you had one slice of bread and one glass of milk. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検査担当へ伝えます。ほかに口にした物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the testing staff. Have you had anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 八時にガムをかみましたが、それ以外はありません。薬はまだ飲んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 八時のガムと未服薬を追加で伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I chewed gum at eight, but nothing else. I haven't taken my medicine yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add that you chewed gum at eight and have not taken your medicine. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その情報も担当者へ伝え、今日の検査をどうするか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass that information on too and check what to do about today's test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 勝手に検査を受けず、判断を待ちます。予定が変わるなら会社への連絡が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 検査判断を待ち予定変更時には会社へ連絡が必要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't go ahead with the test on my own; I'll wait for the decision. If the schedule changes, I need to contact my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will await the decision about the test and need to contact your company if the schedule changes. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お仕事への連絡はご自身でお願いします。検査の予定が分かったらお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please contact your workplace yourself. I'll let you know once the test schedule is clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予定が分かるまでは受付近くで待ちます。変更が決まってから会社へ電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付近くで待ち変更決定後に会社へ電話すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait near reception until the schedule is known. I'll call my company after a change has been decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait near reception and call your company after a change is decided. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 正直にお話しくださってありがとうございます。担当者に確認するまで、お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us honestly. Please wait while I check with the staff member responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾われた鍵ですね。見つけた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: These are keys you found. Please tell me where you found them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅前の交差点のそばで拾いました。青い輪が付いた鍵が三本あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 青い輪の鍵三本を拾ったと伝えて当初の場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found them near the intersection in front of the station. There are three keys attached to a blue ring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found three keys on a blue ring and give the initially stated location. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この地図の駅前交差点でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it this intersection in front of the station on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 地図を見ると違いました。一つ隣の交差点で、歩道橋の階段の下です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図で隣の交差点の歩道橋階段下へ拾得場所を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Looking at the map, I was wrong. It was the next intersection, at the foot of the pedestrian bridge stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the map to correct the location to the foot of the pedestrian bridge stairs at the next intersection. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらへ訂正します。何時ごろ見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll correct it to here. Around what time did you find them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰りのバスを降りた後なので、午後五時二十分ごろです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: バスを降りた後の午後五時二十分ごろと時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was after I got off the bus on my way home, so around five twenty in the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it was around five twenty in the afternoon, after you got off the bus. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 鍵には触れたときから、この青い輪が付いていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Was this blue ring already attached when you first touched the keys?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、そのまま拾いました。どの扉の鍵かは試していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 輪が最初から付いていて鍵を試していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I picked them up just as they were. I haven't tried them in any door.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the ring was attached from the start and you have not tried the keys. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。拾った状況の記録を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Please check the record of how you found them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 場所は歩道橋の階段下、時刻は五時二十分ごろで合っています。最初に言った駅前という記載は消してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録の正しい場所時刻を確認し誤った駅前の記載削除を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: The location at the foot of the pedestrian bridge stairs and the time around five twenty are correct. Please delete the “in front of the station” location I gave at first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the correct place and time in the record and ask them to delete the incorrect station-front location. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正して受け付けます。届けてくださりありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll correct the report and accept it. Thank you for bringing them in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒をお預かりしますが、どうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll take your envelope. What happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ポストの入口に入らなかったので持ってきました。無理に押すと中の書類が折れそうでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 厚い封筒をポストへ押し込まず持参した事情を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought it here because it wouldn't fit into the postbox opening. If I forced it in, I thought the documents inside might bend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you brought the thick envelope rather than forcing it into the postbox. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中身と封筒の厚さを確認して、送る方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the contents and the envelope's thickness, then explain how it can be sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中には書類の束と薄いファイルが入っています。ファイルを外せば薄くなりますが、必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書類束とファイルの中身を伝えファイルを外す必要を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It contains a stack of documents and a thin document folder. Removing the folder would make it thinner, but is that necessary?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it contains documents and a folder and ask whether the folder must be removed. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 料金や扱いは大きさと重さなどで変わります。ファイルを外す前に今の状態で量りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The price and handling vary with size, weight, and other factors. Let's weigh it as it is before removing the folder.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の状態でお願いします。書類の角を守りたいので、できればファイルは残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類保護のためファイルを残し現状の計量を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please weigh it as it is. I'd like to keep the folder if possible to protect the corners of the documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for it to be weighed as it is with the folder kept in to protect the documents. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 重さを確認しました。この形で送る場合の料金はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've checked the weight. Here is the postage if you send it in this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その料金なら払えます。封筒の口が少し開きかけているので、閉じ直してから出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料金を了承し開きかけた封筒を閉じ直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can pay that amount. The envelope is starting to open a little, so I'd like to seal it again before handing it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept the postage and say you want to reseal the envelope that is starting to open. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: しっかり封をしてからお預かりします。宛名が隠れないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll accept it once it is securely sealed. Please make sure the addressee's details aren't covered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛名を避けて封をし直しました。この状態で発送をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名を隠さず封を直したと報告して発送を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've resealed it without covering the addressee's details. Please send it in this condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that you resealed it without covering the addressee's details and ask for it to be sent. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお預かりします。無理に押し込まずお持ちくださり、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll accept it now. Thank you for bringing it here rather than forcing it into the postbox.
